title: 机器学习与AI代理项目集合
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了使用Python构建的机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI及AI自动化项目，涵盖AI代理、LLM应用、NLP、计算机视觉和API工具，代码整洁可扩展，旨在解决实际业务问题。
summary_en: A GitHub repository featuring real-world Python projects in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and AI Automation, including AI agents, LLM apps, NLP, computer vision, and APIs with clean, scalable, well-documented code for solving business challenges.
